notes: Each row serves a sourced value for one fact on current catalog reads. A replacement row corrects a value models.dev publishes, and applies only while the stored upstream value equals its `replaces` exactly: when models.dev moves to any other value the row stops applying and the upstream value is served, so an override can never hide a later upstream change. An addition row (`replaces: null`) supplies a fact models.dev publishes nothing for, and applies only while the stored upstream row has no such fact: if models.dev ever publishes the key, upstream wins and the row stops applying. Nothing here is stored, and point-in-time (`at_ms`) reads serve the recorded value. Every applied row is disclosed in the response's `fact_overrides` list. Only limit.context and limit.output may be replaced, and only capability.server_side_fallback and capability.mid_conversation_system may be added. For capability.mid_conversation_system, claude-mythos-5-1 and claude-mythos-5 are omitted because the embedded seed does not carry them; Anthropic's cited availability sentence already covers them, so add sourced rows once those anthropic model ids enter the catalog.
